questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

310 × 2 - 3 ÷ 40 + 170 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given equation: 310 × 2 − 3 ÷ 40 + 170 = ?

After interchanging ‘+’ and ‘−’ and ‘×’ and ‘÷’, we get:

310 ÷ 2 + 3 × 40 − 170 = ?

Following the BODMAS rule:

= __**310 ÷ 2**__ + 3 × 40 − 170

= 155 + __**3 × 40**__ − 170

= __**155 + 120**__ − 170

= __**275 − 170**__

= 105

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some cameras are radios.

All radios are routers.

Conclusions:

(I): Some cameras are routers.

(II): No camera is a router.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/161ad345bf8645da51ba0369919db83a44e3c5f0721971c0e2606de7b7789f7d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc28a928d49a52f583f793f68b4d556eec475214453c41adfc73abbbb2a13eaf.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some cameras are routers → **True**(As, Some cameras are radios, All radios are routers. so, Some cameras are routers holds true)

(II): No camera is a router → False (As, Some cameras are radios, All radios are routers. so, No cameras is a routers is not true)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

25 + 20 × 10 ÷ 2 − 5 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given equation: 25 + 20 × 10 ÷ 2 − 5 = ?

After interchanging ‘+’ and ‘−’ and ‘×’ and ‘÷’, we get:

25 − 20 ÷ 10 × 2 + 5 = ?

Following the BODMAS rule:

= 25 − __**20 ÷ 10**__ × 2 + 5

= 25 − __**2 × 2**__ + 5

= __**25 − 4**__ + 5

= __**21 + 5**__

= 26

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**

questions.question:
22 is related to 43 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 35 is related to 69. To which of the following is 81 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying, etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number × 2 - 1 = 2nd number.**

22 is related to 43

→ 22 × 2 - 1

→ 44 - 1

→ 43 = 2nd number

35 is related to 69

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

 10, 49

 14, 69
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 2nd number = (1st number × 5) - 1**

**For (10, 49):**

→ (10 × 5) - 1

→ 50 - 1

→ 49

**For (14, 69):**

→ (14 × 5) - 1

→ 70 - 1

→ 69

**Option 1) (17, 88)**

→ (17 × 5) - 1

→ 85 - 1

→ 84

→ Since 84 ≠ 88, this option does not follow the logic.

**Option 2) (18, 88)**

→ (18 × 5) - 1

→ 90 - 1

→ 89

→ Since 89 ≠ 88, this option does not follow the logic.

**Option 3) (18, 89)**

→ (18 × 5) - 1

→ 90 - 1

→ 89

→ This option follows the logic.

**Option 4) (17, 89)**

→ (17 × 5) - 1

→ 85 - 1

→ 84

→ Since 84 ≠ 89, this option does not follow the logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
